evidence.emit_rule: factory/artifacts/basket/phase2/ATLAS/TAPE/OBSERVATION/v0/acquisition/net_reconciliation.json is written ONLY when (a) every parent_sha below matches the file bytes exactly, (b) every target day entry is complete, and (c) the on-disk derived index is byte-identical to the canonical manifest rebuild. A blocked, dry-run, inspected or drifted run prints its report, exits non-zero where it is blocked, and leaves the evidence path untouched.
evidence.not_written_by: this tool never writes blockers_resolved.json, the frozen observation contract/lock, or any market data file; resolution is the parent verification's act and it needs its own evidence shas

market_data_absent_from_contract: this contract names the source files, the hash field that binds each file to its manifest, and the status field that decides completeness. Per-day file/manifest sha256 values and the rebuilt index sha256 are RUN facts and live in net_reconciliation.json, never in a tracked contract.
parent_sha_rule: recomputed from the file bytes at every run; any drift (edited code, edited guard) refuses the stage and no evidence is written. Re-stamp these two values only in the same commit that changes the file.
prohibitions: no source file mutation: bars/, trades/, quotes/, coverage/ and every per-day manifest are read-only; only the derived index is replaced

no parquet is ever opened for data; per-day verification hashes file bytes, the rebuild reads manifests only, and a sealed day's manifest metadata may appear in the index without its bytes ever being read
no network fetch: a missing or corrupt day is reported, never re-acquired
no sealed or reserved day is ever a target: basket_sim.guard_day refuses 2024-*, 2025-01* and 2026-06/07/08 before any path is opened
no fabricated record: a day with a missing file, a missing manifest, a hash mismatch or a non-ok status stays blocked and produces no evidence
purpose: Freeze the provenance rules that let the SIP net DERIVED manifest index be rebuilt and admitted for B6: which physical files and per-day manifests count, which hash field binds them, how the new index is made deterministic, and what completeness a guarded dev-day target must reach before the shared evidence exists.

hash_fields.data: none declared; the census is verified by parse + day id, and the derived bars are bound through the trades source hash below

coverage.kind_marker: the record carries the day census (symbols/rows_merged/classes) and no 'kind' field
coverage.status_semantics: status must be 'ok'; provider_unavailable true blocks the day (provider-side completeness is not claimable)

index.name: manifest_index.jsonl
index.rebuild_inputs: every <root>/*/*.manifest.json for kinds coverage, quotes, trades
index.role: derived artifact - exactly the concatenation of the per-day manifests; it is never a source of truth and is always rebuildable from them

root.default: the resolved market data root's sip/net (BASKET_DATA_ROOT, then the worktree data/, then /home/hillel/projects/Alpacatrader/data); data/sip/net is a symlink onto the SIP archive
root.flag: --root takes an ABSOLUTE net root; a relative root is refused

bars.note: derived bars carry no per-day manifest of their own; coverage/<day>.manifest.json is their provenance record, and the file is admitted only when that record verifies and the day's trades source hash matches

target_completeness.day_rule: a target day is a canonical guarded dev day (basket_sim.dev_days(), the anatomy date stems) and is refused before any path is opened when sealed or reserved
rules: every required file exists, is non-empty and hashes (sha256 of the bytes) as declared by its manifest where the manifest declares a hash
coverage/<day>.manifest.json src_sha256 equals the sha256 of trades/<day>.parquet (the derived bars stay bound to their source)
every required manifest declares the same day id and status 'ok'; coverage provider_unavailable must be false
the rebuilt index carries all three manifest records for the day, byte-equal to the manifests on disk
any missing file, missing kind, hash mismatch, unparsable manifest, day mismatch or non-ok status leaves the day incomplete and emits no evidence

index_determinism.byte_form: one record per line, json.dumps(record, separators=(',', ':'), sort_keys=True) + '\n'
index_determinism.encoding: utf-8, LF terminated, final newline present
index_determinism.inputs: only the per-day manifest JSON objects; no parquet is read and no clock, host or elapsed value is synthesised
index_determinism.ordering: (day, kind rank [coverage < quotes < trades], manifest relpath) - a total order, so the rebuild is byte-identical for identical inputs
index_determinism.replace: write manifest_index.jsonl.tmp then os.replace onto manifest_index.jsonl; a reader never observes a partial index
index_determinism.record_set: all per-day manifests present under the root, including a sealed day's metadata; sealed bytes are never read and sealed days are never reconciliation targets

cli: --stage repair (verify, snapshot, atomic rebuild, re-verify, emit)
--stage verify (read-only: require the index to already be the canonical rebuild, then emit)
--selftest (synthetic: wrong hash, missing kind, missing file, stale/missing rows, sealed and non-dev refusal, deterministic rebuild, contract parent-sha drift)

exit_codes.1: blocked: incomplete day, non-canonical index or contract parent-sha drift (no evidence written)
exit_codes.2: refused: relative or non-net root, or a sealed/reserved/non-dev day
